about: Kinocomputing's house style for images, the site's light palette (kinocomputing note.css, :root). Images are drawn for the light page on a transparent ground; on the site's dark page they are inverted and their hues turned half round, so the ink comes out light. STYLE.md says how to use them.

font.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
